1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Bb4 4.e3 Ne4 5.Qc.strategy: Develops and covers e5 and d4, ready to challenge the outpost with the bishop. Black's knight now relies on the f5 pawn alone, so Black needs more support or has to trade it for the knight on c3.
Prepares ...Bb7 to give the e4 knight a second defender. Black answers the challenge to the outpost by adding force to it rather than trading.
